summary: Beacon Financial Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the retirement of General Counsel Wm. Gordon Prescott effective July 31, 2026, and the appointment of John B. Eagan as successor effective August 1, 2026. Separately, the board adopted an Equity Award Treatment upon Retirement Policy providing continued vesting of time- and performance-based equity awards for eligible Management Committee members and key employees meeting age/service criteria, subject to Committee approval, release of claims, and restrictive covenants. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine officer transition and compensatory policy adoption.
